question: What theorem did Guy Fabrice Foghem Gounoue use to prove existence of Delaunay-type surfaces at AIMS?
answer: He used Crandall-Rabinowitz bifurcation Theorem, to prove the existence of Delaunay-type surfaces which are critical points of the sharp interface limit of the Otha-Kawasaki model.
